plan_b_upgrades.weight_rounding_note: Manifest weights are serialized to 5 decimals (±1e-5); inference renormalizes active weights to 1.0.

conformal_calibration.method_label: AD-stratified Empirical-Bayes shrunk interval (empirically calibrated on nested 5-fold OOF residuals; not an exact finite-sample conformal guarantee)
conformal_calibration.deployment_policy_note: Engineering trade-off for pure-JSON zero-dependency serving: nested-OOF selected mondrian_ad_eb on 48/80 tracks (baseline 13, studentized_cvplus 11, cqr_lgb 8); deployed uniformly across all 80 regression tracks with holdout coverage reported identically from mondrian_ad_eb. Note: cqr_lgb achieved higher overall holdout coverage (79.2%/91.0% dual, min 52.2%) at the cost of .joblib/LightGBM runtime artifacts.

mt46_deep_transfer.reason: Deferred after independent audit flagged post-hoc holdout filtering and unified-vs-per-endpoint train-serve mismatch; all 46 endpoints preserve strict OOF-selected Wave 5A point weights (0.0 diff).

gnn_atom_attribution.architecture: Pure-PyTorch 4-Layer E-GATv2 + Task-Specific WeightAndSum (visualizes the 0.35*y_add residual branch; main predictions come from the 4-FM super-ensemble)
